name: csvreader
description: A CSV schema analysis utility that infers column types and generates or executes CREATE TABLE SQL for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite.

scripts.validate:local: npm run validate:context && npm run validate:generation && npm run validate:sqlite
scripts.validate:database: npm run validate:postgres && npm run validate:mysql
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:local && npm run validate:database
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run validate:local
